title: Study executable lifecycle and build-selection contracts
description: First bounded deep study from docs/research/vasp-source-partition.md. Start with the src build description, object list, conditional configuration, main driver and parallel startup; follow shared state and input entry contracts as needed. Explain supported build variants, run phases, activation of optional subsystems, completion, failure and continuation. Record per-file reading scope and unresolved dependencies in original prose. Treat main as a lifecycle map before following every scientific branch; this task does not encompass all 588 files or engine implementation.
acceptance_criteria: A source-grounded lifecycle and build-selection analysis identifies the examined files and ranges, distinguishes convergence from process termination, records conditional behavior and unresolved cross-partition questions, and proposes concrete reference experiments only where needed.

title: Analyze every file in the VASP source tree and synthesize the hidden complexity
description: User mandate: analyze every file recursively under the quarantined VASP src tree, with no file omitted because it is build glue, bundled numerical code, generated data, an interface, documentation, or a test. Initial measured scope is 588 files and 871419 newline characters. Maintain a reproducible file manifest and explicit unread/partial/analyzed coverage. For each substantive review explain purpose, scientific or operational contract, assumptions, dependencies, numerical choices, failure behavior, reconstruction hazards, and meaningful checks; cite source locations without copying proprietary expression. Synthesize interactions into the versioned parity definition and extensive design. A file count, extracted symbols, or automated summary alone does not complete this work.

title: Establish project direction and partition the complete VASP source tree
description: Record quarantine and public-interface permissions, full parity ambition and permissive licensing. Complete the explicitly scoped orientation: inventory every file recursively under VASP src, assign each to one revisable study area, identify cross-area risks, and propose an order for bounded deep studies. Do not attempt or claim full per-file analysis in this orientation. Deliver reproducible metadata-only inventory, partition rationale and study sequence.
close_reason: Recorded current project direction and research boundary; selected Apache-2.0; assigned all 588 source files once across 20 study areas; documented import-scan limits, cross-area findings and the proposed deep-study order; inventory and structural checks passed.
